creator: bengusberg
title: Side-hustle playbook: screenshot local service businesses from Instagram, have Claude build a booking website, DM it to them and charge ~$1,000

tools.name: Claude
tools.detail: builds one-page booking site from screenshots; screen shows Claude app with 'Sonnet 5 - High' model selector and Chat/Cowork tabs

tools.name: Instagram
tools.detail: prospecting source: businesses with 'DM to book' in bio

claims: AI is bad at new business ideas, good at research and building products
Five minutes after pasting screenshots you have a professional website
Pro web developers charge up to $10,000 for such sites; charge $1,000 'and that would be a steal'
10 minutes of work = $1,000 profit; scale to 1,000 websites with AI
Hook card: 'How to Make $10K/Month With Claude'
how_to_steps: Search Instagram for local service businesses (barbers, nail salons, stylists) whose bio says 'DM to book'
Screenshot their profile and any tagged posts with reviews
Paste into Claude with the prompt: build a professional website for this business with a modern appointment booking system (full prompt on screen)
DM the finished site to the business: 'you're losing money without a website and booking system, I built this for you'
Negotiate a price (~$1,000), then repeat at scale
on_screen_only: Full prompt text: 'Build a professional website for this business with a modern appointment booking system. Use everything in the screenshots: name, services, photos, bio, and tagged reviews. - One-page site, mobile-first, fast - Sections: hero, services + prices, reviews, book now, contact - Booking: pick a service, date, time, then confirm - no login needed - Big "Book Now" button at the top, replaces DM to Book - Colors + tone that match their Instagram - Output one HTML file I can send them today. Do not invent any facts. [paste screenshots here]'
Example output: hair-salon page 'Blondes, Brunettes & Everything In Between' with Blonde/Brunette gallery and 'Book Now' / 'Follow Us' buttons
Model selector: Sonnet 5 - High; Chat / Cowork tabs
cta: Follow for more on AI, founder life, and leadership

relevance.why: A cold-outreach web-design hustle, not a product business; the booking system in 'one HTML file' is not a real booking system. Useful only as a quick-cash or prospecting idea.

implement_score.why: The prompt is a decent template for client landing pages, but a working booking flow needs a backend (Cal.com/Calendly embed at minimum), hosting, and support. Not a fit for a time-poor founder focused on his own apps.

verify: Can a single static HTML file really deliver 'booking' without a backend? (No -- it would need an embed or server.)
Conversion rate of unsolicited DMs with a pre-built site; copyright of scraped photos
Is the $1,000 price realistic for small salons vs Squarespace/Booksy at $20-30/mo?
